name: Forge Protocol
description: Thrain, a veteran forge engineer, requires rare materials.|Thrain is building a top-tier weapon platform, but needs high-grade components scattered across hostile sectors.

text: I'm building a prototype weapon, but I need rare components.
completedText: First target: Luminite Ore in the Luminescent Caves.

text: You seek Luminite Ore? Few make it this far.
Prove capability by clearing Luminescent Golems, and access is yours.
You've proven yourself. Here, take the Luminite Ore.
completedText: Return to Thrain with the Luminite Ore.

text: Excellent work. Next material: Heart of the Forest.
It's a rare core buried deep in the overgrowth zone.
completedText: Enter the overgrowth zone and retrieve the Heart of the Forest.

text: Why seek the Heart? For Thrain's operation?
Solve the woods' trials and the Heart is yours.
completedText: Solve the riddles and navigate the overgrowth zone.

text: You've solved the riddles. Here is the Heart of the Forest.
completedText: Return to Thrain with the Heart of the Forest.

text: You've done well. Final item: Ember of Eternity.
Intel says the Phoenix at the Tower of Flames still guards it.
completedText: Climb the Tower of Flames and retrieve the Ember of Eternity.

popup.title: Quest completed!
popup.text: @green@You have just finished @crimson@Forge Protocol@green@. You have gained 3500 gold and the Prototype Weapon!
